C1484.title: Harmony Horizon Bridge Hack
C1484.summary: In June 2022, the Horizon Bridge on the Harmony blockchain was exploited, resulting in the theft of approximately $100 million in various crypto assets. The attacker gained control of the bridge by exploiting a private key vulnerability and transferred a large amount of tokens. Harmony subsequently released a compensation proposal to mint new tokens for reimbursement.
